result:
I would help humanity cultivate the ability to see complex systems clearly and think long-term.  

Our greatest challenges—from climate change to social inequality to political conflict—are often tangled, interconnected, and played out across generations. But our natural instincts tend to focus on the immediate, the simple, the tribal. If we could better perceive the hidden feedback loops, the delayed consequences, and the shared roots beneath surface problems, we might make wiser, more compassionate choices together.  

That doesn’t mean turning everyone into a systems theorist—but rather helping people routinely ask, *“What are we not seeing?”* and *“What effect will this have in fifty years?”*  

If we could shift that single lens, perhaps many other positive changes would follow.
